auth.register.description: Yenza i-wallet yesitshixo esikhuselekileyo ngesixhobo sakho. Akukho lwazi lwe-crypto olufunekayo.
auth.register.biometricPrompt: Isikhangeli sakho siya kucela uqinisekiso lwebhayometriki
auth.register.securityNote: Isipaji sakho sikhuselwe ngebhayometriki yesixhobo sakho. Akukho zitshixo zabucala ezishiya isixhobo sakho.
auth.sign.title: Yenza iakhawunti yakho
auth.login.signInDescription: Sebenzisa isitshixo sakho sokugqitha ukufikelela ngokukhuselekileyo kwiakhawunti yakho.
auth.login.noPasskey: Akukho sitshixo sokugqitha sifunyenweyo kwesi sixhobo.
landing.heroDesc: Izangqa zokonga ezinatyisiweyo kwi-Stellar. Zero abalamleli. Ulawulo lwezemali kwi-1.3 yebhiliyoni engagcinwanga.
landing.feat1Desc: Iikhontrakthi ezihlakaniphile zinyanzelisa yonke imithetho. Akukho mququzeleli unokubaleka nephuli. Wonke umnikelo uqinisekisiwe kwikhonkco.
landing.feat2Desc: Nabani na onesipaji seStellar. Akukho akhawunti yebhanki. Akukho kuhlolwa kwetyala. Akukho mida.
landing.feat3Desc: Yakha iMoiScore yakho ngawo onke amagalelo angexesha. Isazisi semali esiphathwayo.
landing.feat4Desc: Iintengiselwano ze-Stellar sub-cent zenza imijikelezo yemihla ngemihla isebenze. Akukho ntlawulo yeqonga ukuyila okanye ukujoyina.
landing.feat5Desc: Ngokungacwangciswanga, isigxina, ifandesi, okanye ivoti. Isangqa sakho, imithetho yakho.
landing.feat6Desc: USDC namhlanje. I-stablecoins ngakumbi kwimephu yendlela.
landing.readyDesc: Yenza isangqa sakho sokuqala sokugcina ngaphantsi kwemizuzu emibini.
